method: Proposes Language-Vision-Aware Late Interaction (LVALI) to mitigate semantic bias in multilingual visual document retrieval via token-level weighting and visual alignment correction.
key_assumptions: Semantic bias in multilingual VDR arises from heterogeneous token representations.
Language-aware weighting and visual alignment stability can mitigate bias.
main_contribution: Introduces LVALI framework that improves robustness and cross-lingual consistency in multilingual visual document retrieval.

relation_to_idea.conceptual_difference: Focuses on multilingual visual document retrieval bias mitigation, unrelated to temporal versioning or regulatory QA.
relation_to_idea.basis: Title and abstract describe LVALI for VDR.
